reviews.quotation:
巨門入廟武職權貴，文人不耐久，太陽同有進退，入廟久長，天機同在卯宮吉美，在酉宮雖美無始終，
陷宮遭悔吝，加羊陀火鈴空劫更不美，退宮卸職。
reviews.approvedWording: Trong mục Quan Lộc của bản chép này, trường hợp Cự Môn đồng cung Thiên Cơ tại Mão được ghi “吉美”. Đây là ghi chú về đúng nhánh văn bản, không phải xếp hạng, kết luận toàn bộ công danh hay sự kiện đời đã kiểm chứng; các điều kiện gia sát trong đoạn chưa được đánh giá.

reviews.rationale: MATCH concerns only the direct-host same-palace pair AND Mão textual selector, whose actual engine evaluation agrees with independent Set membership and branch checks for nine API-valid births. It does not certify any natal formula or brightness mapping. In the complete 官祿巨門 entry, 天機同在卯宮吉美 explicitly records the branch named by the selector. The exact Vietnamese wording reports that textual fact and explicitly withholds integrated judgment and evaluation of adverse modifiers. The subsequent adverse/dismissal closure could change a synthesized career interpretation, but cannot erase that the transcription records 吉美 in this branch. It therefore does not prevent this attributed internal annotation under the stated limitations. The preceding military/civil/太陽 clauses and the reciprocal 天機 entry supply no warrant to convert this annotation into rank, profession, grade, actual career prediction or unqualified favorable result. 命宮 stem/sex material is not silently imported as a Quan condition.
